variety_description: A good yielding, early maturity, medium tall, long-slender grain variety grown extensively in irrigated low land conditions. Developed by IIRR &amp; IRRI and released in 1991 for Central &amp; Western India. High tillering. Good grain quality, tolerant to major diseases and insect pest. Extensively used in breeding programs as a base material to develop improved varieties.
